race.description: Max And Doss Smith Memorial Mdn
race.comment: GREY OL' DAY (8) set the pace and kept on kicking to hold onto third place when resuming from a spell at Belmont 11 days ago, and he will be dropping right down in class for this. He had won a trial prior to that recent effort and should be spot on for this. On top. MON VISAGE (13) finished less than a length from the winner in fourth place at Belmont a fortnight ago over 1300m when racing out of her grade, and with a return to maiden class, with 7.5kg less to carry, she does look very well placed to win. WESTERN PHOENIX (12) had been to the fore at the trials prior to finishing sixth on debut at Belmont where he learned a lot from the experience. He has top 3 claims in this. MAJESTIC MIRAGE (14) makes her debut over a distance that may already be too short for her, but she should be finding the line late, so keep her safe. MERCHANT TRADER (3) showed pace at Kalgoorlie last start before fading out to finish fourth. He has 100m less to travel here and could take some catching again.
